Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava

----- 
For the Petitioner : Mr. Abhishek Kumar Dubey, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rakesh Ranjan, A.P.P.
.....
Order No.04/ Dated:15.05.2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Katkamsandi (P) P.S. Case No. 100 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A/ 379/ 323/ 504/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. As per FIR, informant got married to the petitioner and stayed peacefully for a year, thereafter all these accused persons started torturing her mentally and physically on account of non- fulfillment of demand of additional dowry in the form of Rs. 2 lakhs and a gold chain and they also did not provide her with basic amenities.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that after institution of a case for restitution of conjugal rights under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act against his wife which has been decreed.

The informant does not want to reside with the petitioner,
hence, he has lodged this false case which has been culminated in registration of FIR.

During investigation no notice under Section 41(A) Cr.p.c. was issued against the petitioner and at the time of pendency of anticipatory bail application of petitioner before the learned Sessions Judge a show cause notice was issued against the IO as to why he has not issued notice under Section 41 (A)
Cr.p.c. against the petitioner
, thereafter notice was issued and petitioner has complied with the notice and is co-operating in the investigation.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the further investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation coupled with materials on record, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Hazaribag in connection with Katkamsandi (P) P.S. Case No.
100 of 2022 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
